input.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic for a website, wide landscape composition on a pure white background, corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, matching a light blue and yellow illustration set. Show the six factors that drive RPA implementation cost as exactly six identical rounded-square tiles arranged in exactly two rows of exactly three tiles each (a 3 by 2 grid, six tiles in total, never four columns, never eight tiles), with even gutters and the grid centered on the canvas. All six tiles have exactly the same pale blue #E7F0FB fill with no highlighted, selected, darker or lighter tile. Each tile has one simple line-and-fill icon centered in the upper two-thirds and one short bold navy label centered in the lower third, in a clean sans-serif font at a moderate size so every label fits on one line with clear padding. Icons contain no lettering. Tile 1 icon: a flowchart with several connected boxes; label exactly 'Process Complexity'. Tile 2 icon: a scanned page with a wavy handwritten line and a magnifying glass; label exactly 'Document Quality'. Tile 3 icon: three overlapping page layouts of different shapes; label exactly 'Layout Variations'. Tile 4 icon: two computer screens joined by a two-way arrow; label exactly 'Systems Integrated'. Tile 5 icon: a stack of documents with a small upward bar chart; label exactly 'Monthly Volume'. Tile 6 icon: a wrench and a circular arrow around a small gear; label exactly 'Maintenance & Support'. A single small yellow spark near the top-right corner. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, navy #1F2A44, soft green #3BB273, white. Generous outer margins, crisp edges, no connecting lines, no arrows between tiles, no dotted lines. The only text in the image is the six labels, all bold and perfectly spelled.
